original_query: Sort the data by the 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' column in descending order to identify which vintage years had the highest relative performance compared to the S&P 500.
optimized_code:
import pandas as pd

# Load the data from the CSV file into a DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Check if the DataFrame is not empty before sorting
if not df.empty:
    # Sort the DataFrame by 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' in descending order
    sorted_df = df.sort_values(by='LN PME Using S&P 500 TR', ascending=False)
    
    # Save the sorted DataFrame to a new CSV file
    sorted_df.to_csv('output.csv', index=False)
else:
    print("The DataFrame is empty. Please check the CSV file.")
